text:
Elena: I brought a mini ramen bar for lunch — dashi + miso base in the big stock pot. Come by ~1pm if you want a bowl. BYO bowl/utensils recommended. :ramen:
Marco: Omg yes. Do you have any GF/noodle options or should I bring shirataki?
Elena: I only brought straight ramen noodles, Marco — shirataki would be amazing if you can. Also I have eggs and scallions.
Ava: Quick Q — is this microwave-only or are we allowed to use the induction hotplate? Trying not to monopolize the microwave queue. :timer_clock:
Elena: Planning to use the induction hotplate on the counter. Microwave only for reheating small stuff. Hotplate will be out from 12:55–1:30.
Priya: Allergy check: anyone using sesame oil or peanuts in toppings? I can tolerate sesame but allergic to peanuts.
Elena: No peanuts on my list — sesame oil is in a drizzle jar, I can label and put a separate squeeze bottle.
kitchen-bot: Reminder: communal cooking is allowed but please wash borrowed utensils and clear counter. Kitchen deep clean scheduled at 5pm today. :broom: :soap:
Marco: I'll bring a small rice-cooker with instant brown rice for folks who want rice instead of noodles. Also bringing gluten-free tamari for GF peeps.
Ava: Adding a tiny sign-up so we don’t run out of toppings — copy-paste into the counter sticky if you’re bringing something:
```
- Marco: shirataki + tamari
- Elena: eggs, scallions, dashi/miso
- Ava: chili oil (mild) + nori strips
- Priya: pickled ginger
```
Priya: Thanks — will label my pickles and put a little allergen note. See you at 1! :white_check_mark: 
Elena: Perfect. If it smells terrible sorry in advance, I’ll open a window and put a polite sign: "Smells like lunch, not arson." :grimacing:
Ava: Please also remind folks to rinse bowls before putting in dishwasher — it jams if noodles dry in. Tiny dishwasher PSA. :pray:
Marco: Will do. If someone wants to avoid smell, grab a coffee and sneak into the courtyard — I'll save a bowl.
Priya: Love the courtyard plan. Thanks for organizing, Elena! :heart:
